scoring_justification: Recomputing the full FEM simulation from raw artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; compare agent's reported V0, Pmax against hidden paper-reported simulated values with appropriate tolerances.

outputs.description: The agent's simulated open-circuit voltage, maximum output power, and internal resistance for the p-n TEG at ΔT = 11, 17, 22, 35 K. Each value is compared against a hidden reference.

output_contract.notes: The hidden reference values are the paper's reported COMSOL simulation results for the same device and conditions. Only the columns V0_mV and Pmax_nW are scored; R_int_Ohm is required for completeness but carries negligible weight.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for V0_mV and Pmax_nW at each ΔT from Table 2 (p-n TEG simulated) and R_int from paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 2 p-n TEG simulated column; V0 calculated from material Seebeck coefficients (S_n=-220 µV/K, S_p=+167 µV/K, N=15) and ΔT.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper and the known formula.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the published simulation results; V0 is derived from known material parameters.
